real_defects.issue: parseSpfMechanisms set allNotLast for any term after "all", so the legal and common `v=spf1 ... -all exp=explain...` (a modifier, allowed anywhere by RFC 7208 s6) got a false 'nothing after all is ever reached' notice. Mechanisms after all were also counted toward the 10-lookup budget, fetched, and checked for void lookups though s5.1 says they are never evaluated. Fixed: only a mechanism after all sets allNotLast, and such mechanisms cost no lookup; tests in analyze.test.mjs and lookup.test.mjs.

`v=spf1 ~all -all` was reported as invalid syntax (spf-malformed, danger, 'PermError for every message') though RFC 7208's ABNF allows it, and allQualifier took the LAST all ('-', strict) while evaluation stops at the first ('~', softfail), overstating the policy. Fixed: first all decides, a later one is an unreachable term (notice); test in analyze.test.mjs.

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
